title.narrative: RI8. Share of schools with teachers trained in first aid

comment.narrative: Implementation is on track. The baseline form has been prepared by MoE, which will be used to verify the Baseline at national level. To achieve the set target, in 2025 the aim is to start by training groups of selected teachers to become trainers on how to deliver first aid. AEDs will also be purchased for selected schools, along with other first aid materials. This indicator measures the share of schools with teachers trained in first aid and provided with AED and bleeding control kits.

title.narrative: RI8. Share of schools with teachers trained in first aid

comment.narrative: The indicator will share of schools with teachers trained to provide first aid and provided with of AED and bleeding control kits. A survey will be conducted at the start of the operation to establish the baseline. The indicator will measure progress in urban and rural schools

title.narrative: RI9. Share of zero-emission buses and mini-buses as part of public transportation fleet

comment.narrative: Implementation is on track. A set of new Sustainable Urban Mobility Plans (SUMPs) were developed. Activities will continue to be implemented in line with the public policy framework for zero-emission busses and minibuses. This indicator measures the increase of the total stock of vehicles of categories M1, M2, and M3 owned by rural and urban counties and/or used for public passenger transport, that are zero-emission vehicles.

title.narrative: RI9. Share of zero-emission buses and mini-buses as part of public transportation fleet

comment.narrative: The indicator will measure the increase of the total stock of vehicles of categories M1, M2, and M3 (including systems, components, and separate technical units intended for such vehicles) owned by rural and urban counties and/or used for public passenger transport, that are zero-emission vehicles. The data will be monitored and collected by the MPWDA.

title.narrative: RI4. Number of people that benefit from improved access to early warning (cumulative)

comment.narrative: Implementation is on track. A dam break analysis is being developed (to update the first analysis performed in 2013), the results of which will inform the setting up of additional sirens. Audibility studies are also being conducted. This indicator measures the number of people benefitting from the expansion of the early warning system through the establishment of 500 new sirens for hydrometeorological hazards and other emergencies, implemented by the â€˜â€™Romanian Watersâ€™â€™ Agency under the MEWF.

title.narrative: People with enhanced resilience to climate risks

comment.narrative: Implementation is on track. Feasibility studies for the fire stations and warehouses have been either completed, under preparation or are pending approval. A memorandum for welcoming new staff will be issued for 2025. This indicator measures the cumulative number of people benefitting from enhanced disaster and climate response. The response network will be expanded by establishing new fire/paramedic and intervention units (from current 284 to 299), logistics centers (from current three to seven), and increasing the number of professional emergency response staff in GIES and CIES (by 800).

This indicator measures the cumulative number of people living in Areas of Potential Significant Flood Risk who benefit from high priority prevention and protection measures to reduce flood risk, as prioritized in Romaniaâ€™s second cycle Flood Risk Management Plans and as reported to the European Commission in September 2023.

title.narrative: RI2. Number of people with disabilities with completed self-preparedness plans for emergencies (cumulative)

comment.narrative: Implementation is on track. The Fii PregÄƒtit platform was updated with information and guides adapted to the needs of people with disabilities. title.narrative: RI3.Share of intervention units nationwide with first responders equipped with knowledge on how to identify GBV cases and employ effective referral mechanisms to link survivors with essential services

comment.narrative: Implementation is on track. Preliminary discussions took place on the relevant topics and preferred teaching approach to the GBV trainings. comment.narrative: The indicator will measure the share of intervention units nation-wide with first responders that receive GBV training in relevant format/delivery mode, as well as the number of trained intervention units to capture the geographical coverage and the change of the system. title.narrative: RI5. The updated general procedures for the national RO-ALERT warning system have been approved by the National Committee for Emergency Situations (NCES)

comment.narrative: Implementation is on track. Meetings between the relevant authorities and private entities took place to discuss about the potential solutions to improving the alerting system of RO-ALERT, by new levels of alerts, depending on the severity level (i.e. by introducing the amber notification solution). This indicator will capture the following modernization reforms for RO-ALERT EWS: (i) linking RO-ALERT with other EWS to improve the speed of warning, especially for meteorological hazards; (ii) updating sound alerts considering the potential impact on the population; and (iii) modernizing communication to make it more accessible to vulnerable groups, including people with disabilities, and to offer improved information on resources to prevent and/or address cases of GBV in disasters/crisis.
